EASEMENTAGREEMENT 2008 between THE PORT AUTHORITY OF NEW YORK AND NEW JERSEY ("Grantor,"' r NewYork and New Jersey with the consent of the Congress of the United States of America, NEW YORK (the “City"), a municipal corporation of the State of New York, having an office at CityHall, NewYork,NewYork 10007. WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Grantor is the owner of a certain parcel of real property, known as Block as more particularly described in “Exhibit A"” attached hereto and made a part hereof; WHEREAS, the City plans to extend a subway line, commonly known as the Number 7 Line (the “No. 7 Line"), to the west along 41st Street and to the south along 11th Avenue to approximately 34th Street, with additional underground facilities to 24th Street (collectively, the "Extension"), a portion of which will go through the Easement Site; WHEREAS, said No.7 Line is, and the Extension will be, leased by the City to the New York City Transit Authority, a public benefit corporation chartered by the New York State Legislature, pursuant to an Agreement of Lease, dated as of June 1, 1953, and subsequently amended and extended (the “Lease"); WHEREAS,in order tofacilitatetheExtension,Grantee(as hereinafter defined)has requested that Grantor grant an exclusive perpetual easement under and through the subsurface of the Easement Site; and WHEREAS, Grantor desires to grant the Easement (as hereinafter defined) and Grantee desires to accept the Easement on the terms and conditions hereinafter provided. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the covenants and mutual premises herein contained, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which s 1.Grant of Easement (a) Grantor, for itself, its successors and assigns, for the benefit and use of the City, including any department, bureau, board, commission, agency or instrumentality thereof (the “Grantee"), and its successors and assigns, and its licensees, lessees or other designees, does hereby grant, establish, create and declare an exclusive perpetual easement (the “Easement") under andthrough thesubsurfaceof theEasementSite,asshown on themapfor theEasement Site in Exhibit A,subject to Section 11 of this Easement Agreement, for the sole purpose of installing, maintaining, operating and inspecting a subway tunnel and other subway facilities, including, but not limited to, ingress, egress and access of trains, personnel, vehicles and Block 1050, Lot 13; 121307.v1

equipment, subject to the terms and conditions of this Easement Agreement (the “Subway Improvements"). Grantee hereby acknowledges and agrees that Grantor has made no representations,warranties or promises as to the suitability or physical condition of the Easement Site,the usefulness or worth of theEasement Site,the liabilities and obligationshereby assumed by Grantee associated with the Easement Site or resulting from any use thereof or any activity thereon, or otherwise, Grantee accepting all risks, including without limitation, the "As Is" condition of such property and any latent or other faults thereof in connection therewith and absolving Grantor from all obligations or responsibilities thereof. (b) Grantee, and its successors and assigns, and its licensees, lessees or other designees, shall have the perpetual and exclusive right to use the Easement Site for the Subway Improvements on the terms and conditions provided in this Easement Agreement. (c) Grantor retains, reserves, and shall continue to enjoy the use of the Easement Site for any and all purposes not inconsistent with the Easement. Any conflict which may develop in regard to the use by Grantor, Grantee or others shall be resolved in favor of Grantor, with Grantor's rights having priority, provided such does not preclude Grantee's reasonable access and use hereunder,nor unreasonably interfere with construction work related with the Subway Improvements,with the exception of emergency situations affecting or threatening to affect life, limb, property or the public interest. Accordingly, notwithstanding the within grant of the Easement or any provision hereof to the contrary and by way of limiting and conditioning the rights provided under this Section 1,the same shall be exercised in such manner and to such degree as not to impair, impede, present additional risk, increase Grantor's costs with respect to or adversely affect Grantor's rights or interest in the Easement Site or otherwise,in the sole and absolute judgment of Grantor, which judgment shall not be exercised in an arbitrary or capricious manner, and shall be subject to the use of the Easement Site by Grantor in connection with its operations or related operations and as set forth in all prior easement agreements of Grantor or its successors and assigns, whether on the Easement Site or elsewhere, including, repair, support or other activity or function related thereto. (d)Grantor acknowledges that it has reviewed a set of plans and specifications identified as “Contract No. C26503, Construction of Running Tunnels and Station Structures - NUMBER 7 (FLUSHING) LINE EXTENSION" (the “Contract"). The shop drawings, and the means and methods of construction in connection with the Contract remain subject to review and concurrence by Grantor. Subject to such plans and specifications, as the same have been finally reviewed by the Port Authority, Grantor shall have the right to require Grantee, during its performance of any work on the Easement Site with respect to the Subway Improvements, to maintain safe, uninterrupted, unimpeded and unobstructed passage by all parties across the Easement Site and to protect the persons and property of all parties then using such area or any area proximate thereto from harm, injury, damage and loss arising from such work. (e) Grantor and Grantee hereby acknowledge that the grant of the Easement referredtointhisSectionshallbeleasedbytheCitytotheNewYorkCityTransitAuthority ("TA") pursuant to the Lease.
